title: Injectivity of the tuple code
statement: For nonnegative integers $n,k$, an injective $k$-tuple of elements of an $n$-element set is encoded by its image, a $k$-element subset, together with a bijection from the $k$ positions to that subset. This encoding is injective: two tuples with the same code are equal.
hypotheses_covered: The input is an injective tuple of length $k$ with entries among $n$ labels
